posts.title: Dubbing the tape
posts.excerpt: One hundred tapes, real time, one side at a time, on a borrowed Tascam.

posts.title: Glasgow, the Hug and Pint
posts.excerpt: Sold the last tour tote at 11:40pm to someone who had driven from Dundee.

posts.title: Print night at Hyde Park
posts.excerpt: Priya pulled 200 car park tees in two sessions.

posts.title: Drop six: flood tee
posts.content: White tee, one-colour black print of the crowd at the Wharf Chambers flood show, when the ceiling leaked on the drum riser. 150 made. Sold out in nine days.
posts.excerpt: White tee, 150 made, sold out in nine days.

posts.title: Drop five: tour tote
posts.content: Heavy canvas tote with every date of the spring tour handwritten by Mags on the back, including the two that got cancelled. 80 made. The last one went at the Glasgow show.

posts.title: Drop four: lighthouse longsleeve
posts.content: Our first longsleeve, printed on both arms, which is why we have never made another. 60 made. Sold out.
posts.excerpt: 60 made. The sleeves nearly finished Priya.

posts.title: Drop three: demo tape
posts.content: Four songs on a C30, dubbed on a borrowed Tascam and wrapped in a photocopied J-card. 50 made. Mostly bought by our mums, who then bought more.

posts.title: Drop two: amp tee
posts.content: A photo of Tom's practice amp, photocopied until the knobs looked like eyes. 100 made, sold out in a month.
posts.excerpt: The amp photo that looks like a face.

posts.title: Drop one: the holdall tees
posts.content: Forty tees sold out of a holdall at our first six shows, in 2021. No website, cash only. We still have one, framed, in the practice room.
